history_rule: 60 consecutive calendar dates d-60 through d-1; missing history is an error
validation_rule: next cyclic test pair; select one ridge alpha per fold on validation-period two-station aggregate WAPE only; finish all selections before test prediction
alpha_grid_provenance: new reconstruction design using the paper ridge candidate set, not recovered original local-ridge hyperparameters
tie_break: smallest numeric ridge alpha on exactly equal validation WAPE
normalization: local 60-day input mean and population standard deviation; exact constant or standard deviation <1e-12 columns have zero fitted coefficient
objective: sum squared multi-output residual error + ridge_alpha * Frobenius(weight)^2; intercept unpenalized
target: cache y_residual; do not standardize target or add output clipping except nonnegative final load
solver: float64 centered dual SPD Cholesky solve; no random optimization
fairness: separate raw/+group/+group+risk evidence from exactly existing E2 functions and paper_config; same test-start warmup; no new retuning
historical_summary_comparison: report differences from old 0.1025/0.0727; never an acceptance or tuning target; update all paper row metrics together from new predictions after audit
paper_adoption_requires: scientific review; no requirement on direction or p<0.05; no mixture of historical errors with new p values
archival_policy: never overwrite main, frozen OOF, results_reference, results_reproduced, or previous revision results; full OOF retained locally, light evidence later committed

dependency_pin_maintenance.acceptance_rule: Before preparation or formal run, controller must verify that the working file, Git index and pinned parent-commit blob all match this exact canonical SHA; parse without execution and require an empty module or one module docstring only. If any check fails, export source diagnostics and stop before installing or staging payload.
